msg: warning: Variable line is used uninitialized!
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 192c35f6eb2.c (BusyBox syslogd). Uninitialized value on 'line' at line 12, when def(CONFIG_FEATURE_REMOTE_LOG). 'line' is declared as 'static char line[512]' at line 6. Static variables in C are automatically zero-initialized by the C runtime — they are always initialized before use. The alarm is incorrect. Additionally, line 12 itself calls memset(&line, 0, sizeof(line)) which explicitly zeros it before use at line 13. No real bug exists here.
